items.author: Peter Yang
items.summary: Peter Yang ranks the personal-agent race and picks Meta's Muse as the likely winner, predicting it becomes Meta's biggest homegrown app after Facebook itself — bigger than Threads — thanks to an intuitive app and aggressive cross-promotion. He rates ChatGPT the current leader purely on its 1B+ user base despite a confusing work/personal split, dismisses Grok Bot as a work-only play that could become "multiplayer agentic Slack," and calls Google a dark horse that needs to stop burying Spark inside Gemini. His real prediction: nobody has solved multiplayer AI yet — you still can't loop a spouse or coworker into one agent thread — and that's the next big unlock. His own stack today: Muse for personal, Grok Bot for cloud tasks, Claude for specific use cases, and ChatGPT for everything else.
items.summaryZh: Peter Yang给个人agent赛道的选手打分,认为Meta的Muse最有可能胜出,预测它会成为Meta继Facebook之后最成功的自研产品——超过Threads——原因是App体验足够直观,加上Meta在旗下所有产品线上的强力交叉推广。他认为ChatGPT目前仍是领跑者,但纯粹是靠10亿+的用户规模,尽管工作版和个人版的划分让人摸不着头脑;他觉得Grok Bot算不上Muse的真正对手,更像是在往"多人协作的agentic版Slack"方向发展;他把Google视为一匹黑马,但前提是Google得别再把Spark藏在Gemini里当二级标签。他真正的预测是:目前还没有人真正解决多人agent协作的问题——你还没法把配偶或同事直接拉进同一个agent对话——他认为这会是下一个大机会。他目前自己的工具组合是:个人事务用Muse,云端任务用Grok Bot,特定场景用Claude,其余一切用ChatGPT。

items.author: Guillermo Rauch
items.summary: Vercel CEO Guillermo Rauch says the thoroughness of agentic QA is now "unrivaled" by humans: he flagged a rendering bug in a mobile in-app browser and watched an agent chase it "to the depths of Mordor" — reproducing it, spinning up an ephemeral Vercel deployment, throwing it at an iPhone simulator, then fixing, deploying, and verifying the fix end to end. His takeaway is blunt: humans could never match that level of grinding intensity — we'd run out of energy and extrapolate instead of exhaustively verifying — and he expects software quality and performance to reach levels never experienced before as a result.
items.summaryZh: Vercel首席执行官Guillermo Rauch表示,agent做QA的彻底程度如今"无人能及":他指出一个移动端应用内浏览器的渲染问题后,眼看着agent一路追查到"魔多的最深处"——复现问题、创建一个临时的Vercel部署、丢到iPhone模拟器里测试,然后修复、部署、验证,全流程走完。他的结论很直接:人类根本比不了这种不知疲倦的高强度——我们会精力耗尽,会靠外推猜测而不是穷尽式验证——他认为这种转变会带来前所未有的软件质量和性能水平。
